mapper.select:
select v.id, v.name, v.file_id, v.poster_id, v.duration, v.create_time, v.del_flag, v.description, v.hits, v.is_show, f1.file_url as videoUrl, f2.file_url as posterUrl, f1.size from resource_video v left join file_info f1 on v.file_id = f1.id left join file_info f2 on v.poster_id = f2.id where v.del_flag = '0'
and v.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')

select v.id, v.name, v.file_id, v.poster_id, v.duration, v.create_time, v.del_flag, v.description, v.hits, v.is_show, f1.file_url as videoUrl, f2.file_url as posterUrl, f1.size from resource_video v left join file_info f1 on v.file_id = f1.id left join file_info f2 on v.poster_id = f2.id where v.del_flag = '0' and v.is_show = 1
and v.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
